added.text: ^$25 for your first month with a 12-month or 6-month plan.
After the first month, membership continues for $74/mo (12-month plan) or $84/mo (6-month plan) for the remainder of your applicable plan term.
Plans auto-renew for another 12-month or 6-month period at the same monthly rate at the end of each plan term.
